advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational
 objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

 Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
 Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

 In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with
 the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised if necessary.)
 Students are expected to pursue identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering
 process.

 In this laboratory, the molding process phenomena in plastics and other materials are clarified by experiments
 or numerical analysis. In addition, numerical analysis models are constructed using this knowledge, and a
 molding process simulation technology is established. Furthermore, the mechanism of molding fault phenomena
 is clarified by a simulation of the molding process to realize high-quality manufacturing.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

               This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational
 objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

 Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
 Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

 In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with
 the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised if necessary.)
 Students are expected to pursue identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering
 process.

 In this laboratory, the molding process phenomena in plastics and other materials are clarified by experiments
 or numerical analysis. In addition, numerical analysis models are constructed using this knowledge, and a
 molding process simulation technology is established. Furthermore, the mechanism of molding fault phenomena
 is clarified by a simulation of the molding process to realize high-quality manufacturing.
